---
name: Software record
about: Add or update research software linked to an IRP and a paper
---

Use **Add software** on the website to prepare a proposal. Paste downloaded JSON
inside exactly one fenced `json` block if needed.

Include the repository, software name, authors, languages, IRPs, linked paper(s),
category and data availability notes. Index links and software DOIs are optional.
An optional plot needs a direct public image URL and descriptive alt text.

Maintainers: review the record, then add `software-approved`. The workflow
validates and applies the CSV change and requests deployment. Do not include
credentials, private data or private manuscripts.
